mapper.insert: MERGE INTO TB_PROJ_MEMBER T USING DUAL ON (T.PROJ_ID = #{projId} AND T.EMP_ID = #{empId}) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET T.LEAVE_DT = NULL, T.JOIN_DT = SYSDATE WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (PROJ_ID, EMP_ID, JOIN_DT) VALUES (#{projId}, #{empId}, SYSDATE)
mapper.select: SELECT EMP_ID, PROJ_ID, JOIN_DT, LEAVE_DT FROM TB_PROJ_MEMBER WHERE PROJ_ID = #{projId} AND LEAVE_DT IS NULL
